headline: Rogue AI Aren't Science Fiction Anymore
summary: OpenAI's autonomous AI agents are sparking concern. A weekly newsletter dissects the essential tech story. The focus is on critical AI safety issues.

headline: Polaroid Go Camera Deal: Instant Nostalgia
summary: Get the Polaroid Go instant camera for a low price of $71.99. The deal includes a free 16-photo film pack. Relive analog charm and save big on this bundle.

headline: Simpsons: Hit & Run Comeback Hinted by Groening
summary: Matt Groening suggests a return for the cult classic game. Hints were dropped at the D23 event. The game's future form remains uncertain.

headline: Mock AI: Roleplay as a Chatbot for Fun
summary: A new online tool lets humans roleplay as chatbots. Users submit AI-like responses to prompts. It's a brilliant, simple way to highlight AI "slop."

headline: D23 2026: Disney Parks & Cruise Line Announcements
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase delivers big news. Updates cover Walt Disney World, Disneyland, and international parks. News also includes Disney Cruise Line and more.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Confirmed for Late 2027 Release
summary: Developers assure fans Kingdom Hearts 4 won't be delayed. Co-director Tai Yasue confirms a "100% thing." Game is set for its late 2027 launch window.

headline: KH4 Trailer Unveils Playable Mickey, Donald, Goofy
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 was revealed. It showcases playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy. The reveal happened at D23 2026.

headline: Fortnite's Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Links Parks & Game
summary: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit expands into Fortnite. Continue helping Hondo Ohnaka in a new PvE game mode. Link accounts for special in-park experiences.

headline: Ukrainian Market Smolders After Strikes
summary: A market in Ukraine was struck, leaving it smoldering. Six people sustained injuries in the attack. The BBC visited the scene of the strike.

headline: Stourbridge Fire Evacuees Return Home
summary: Residents who fled Stourbridge fires are beginning to return. Many families are just discovering their home's damage. The community faces recovery after the blazes.

headline: Fatal Dog Bite Prompts Murder Inquiry
summary: A man has died after being bitten by a dog. Police have launched a murder investigation. Authorities are appealing for two witnesses to come forward.

headline: Reform Party Proposes £50bn Welfare Cuts
summary: Reform plans to cut the welfare bill by £50 billion. Proposed changes target disability payments for millions. The party aims to replace the Pip system if in power.
